title: HELIX Bridge: Banner → Enrollment
description: Maps Ellucian Banner SIS registration tables to the HELIX Enrollment resource.

source_tables.description: Student Course Registration. One row per student per CRN per term.
Course History/Transcript. Final grades and credit hours earned.
Section Base. Section details (used for course_section_ref resolution).

attribute_mappings.transformation: Deterministic UUID from institution_id + SFRSTCR_PIDM + SFRSTCR_TERM_CODE + SFRSTCR_CRN
Resolve to HELIX Student.helix_id via PIDM lookup
Resolve to HELIX CourseSection.helix_id via CRN + term lookup against SSBSECT
Resolve to HELIX AcademicPeriod.helix_id via term code lookup

Map Banner registration status codes: 'RE','RW','RA'→'registered', 'WL'→'waitlisted', 'DD','DW'→'dropped', 'W'→'withdrawn', 'AU'→'auditing'. Post-grading: if SHRTCKN exists with final grade → 'completed'. Institution-specific codes in STVRSTS.
attribute_mappings.notes: Use the most recent SFRSTCR record per PIDM+TERM+CRN (max SFRSTCR_SEQ_NUMB).

attribute_mappings.transformation: Cast to ISO 8601 date. Use earliest registration activity for the CRN.
Cast to ISO 8601 date. Null if not dropped/withdrawn.
Direct map from transcript. Null if course not yet completed.
Direct map from transcript. Null if in progress.
Direct map. Quality points = grade value × credit hours.
Map Banner grade mode codes to HELIX: 'S'→'standard', 'P'→'pass_fail', 'A'→'audit'. Institution-specific codes in STVGMOD.
Map: 'I','E','X'→true, null→false. Institution repeat rules vary.
